answer: Copying the same citations across 200 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 200 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the prism index resolves every citation against the island checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the ferrous audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 3307 identities would post 3980 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
